utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wait, I thought we agreed on 10. I've got tools ready for 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, you're right, Leo! I must have mixed up the time. Let's stick with 10—thanks for being ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you at 10 then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, Jules offered to help round people up, so I think we're good on that front. Honestly, I keep forgetting half the details—what did I say we were fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's mostly small household repairs and outdoor fixes—like squeaky doors, broken fences, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, right—squeaky doors and fences. Got it. So where are we meeting up, or did I miss that part too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Count me in for that—I can wrangle some neighbors to drop off their tools at a central spot if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly is the repair drive for? I want to make sure we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a community event where we fix broken items for neighbors who can't afford repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, it's for the playground equipment then — glad I checked. Did you see those frayed chains on the swing set too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, those swings are looking rough! I bet Leo could take a look at them while we're at it—he's got a real knack for fixing things like that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Leo? That's a good idea — he's always been handy with tools. Should we ask him this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, so it's at the community center parking lot on Saturday? I have an old lamp that needs rewiring. Do you know if there's a limit on what they'll fix?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I don't think there's a limit, Opal. They're pretty open to fixing most things. I'll bring my tools, so we can definitely take a look at that lamp.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's a relief, Gus. Thanks for bringing your tools—I'll see you at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's definitely a repair drive — Vik's been gathering tools and stuff for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so Vik's the one running it? I've heard bits and pieces—people are really pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Vik's really been the one spearheading it. I offered to grab supplies while I'm out—seems like there's a lot of folks wanting to help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Saturday — thanks for reminding me! I think I've got a toaster somewhere in the back of my closet, if I can remember where I put it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: A toaster? I'm pretty handy with small appliances. Want me to take a look at it during the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that'd be great, Sam! I think it's just a loose wire or something... I'll dig it out tonight if I can remember which closet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a bit from Dane. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 9 AM, but we'd love to have you there whenever you can make it — even just for an hour helps!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I can probably come for a couple hours in the morning. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Cleo, guess what! Gus just told me he's lending tools for that repair drive on Maple Street. They're meeting at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great news, Tess! I'll add Gus to my list of tool donors. Every little bit helps for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: And I heard they're still looking for someone who knows how to fix sewing machines — you don't happen to know anyone, do you, Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira! Don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. I've been telling everyone to bring their broken items!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure it's a repair drive? I thought I heard something about a yard sale instead.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh no, it's definitely a repair drive! I've been reminding Oren and Ira about it all week — Saturday at the community center, bring your broken stuff for fixing!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. I might take you up on that offer once I sort out the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just let me know as soon as you have the list, so I can go over it with you before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do. I'll make sure you see it before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mainly hammers, saws, and some paintbrushes—I think a few folks are bringing their drills too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive. I've got an old drill somewhere. What's the time again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: We're kicking off at 10 AM on Saturday, but knowing me, I'll probably roll in around 10:30!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I'm heading to the hardware store for some supplies — Vik mentioned we need a few things for the repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Where exactly is this repair drive taking place?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's at the community center on Maple Street—Vik's got the workshop set up in the back room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, did you catch wind of that repair drive on Maple Street? They'll be fixing up old bikes and appliances for those who need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, I heard about it from Uli! Sounds like a great way to help out the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they're meeting at the community center on Saturday morning if you want to swing by. I'm planning to bring some old tools myself.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it's the community fixing up stuff together—tools, bikes, that sort of thing. You might want to check the notice board down the street.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the notice board. I keep meaning to look at that. Maybe I'll swing by later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good idea, I think there's a flyer with times and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly hammers, saws, and maybe a level or two. Nothing too fancy—we’re just patching up some boards and gates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, we'll need all that for the drive Saturday at the community center. Make sure you bring those tools!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, I'll dig out my hammer and bring it along—see you there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. Do we have enough spare parts too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check my shed for any spare parts if you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, Rey. Could you also check if there are any specific bolts or screws we might be missing? I'd hate to start and find we're short on those.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for clarifying, Cleo. So we need tools for the playground and garden shed—I have some spare screws and a hammer we could contribute.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I've got a spare shovel and some heavy gloves we can throw in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, Leo, a shovel and gloves will come in handy. Should we also check if anyone has a replacement chain for the swing set?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a good set of tools in my truck, but let me grab my master toolkit just in case—I don't want us to be caught short.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like you're all set, Gus! I'll make sure the coffee's flowing and the donuts are fresh for when we break a sweat.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ha! A good cup of coffee is half the battle—I'll be over in a jiffy with my tool chest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I might take you up on that tool roundup—it's the part I'm worst at organizing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Uli! I'll be sorting tools on Saturday morning with Mara — wanna join us and make it a team effort?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Sam. I'll be there Saturday morning—thanks for including me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sam! I was just thinking about you. You still good to help sort those donated tools this Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be there at 9 AM sharp to help organize.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Eli! With you and Sam both coming, we'll have that tool station set up in no time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, tools. I've got an old drill in the garage—might be dusty, but I'll try to find it later. Need to run!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Bo—before you go, do you know where the repair drive is actually happening? I need to confirm the spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, um, I think Cleo mentioned the community center? Or maybe the park? Honestly, I'm not sure—gotta dash!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, I'm so glad I ran into you! We're organizing a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday, and I was wondering if you'd be available to help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You and Ira both mentioned it, but I'm still not sure — are we talking about fixing old appliances or something else?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's exactly that, Kira — we're getting together to fix up old appliances, patch up fences, and lend a hand with any small repairs folks might need around their homes. Starts at 9 AM Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday! Right, that sounds familiar. I think I even wrote it down somewhere... probably.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great! We'll be at the community center from 9 to 3. Bring any spare tools or materials you've got!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, tools! I've got a whole box of random screws somewhere—if I can remember where I put it. And my toaster's still sitting on the counter, waiting.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
